This is for the site's own pages. A message from the engine itself (a rule's title, a finding's summary or hint, the HTML report) goes to the engine's repository instead: https://github.com/SureA11y/core/issues/new?template=translation.md

## Language

<!-- e.g. Portuguese (pt), French (fr) -->

## What this is about

- [ ] A text on the site that is wrong, unclear or uses unusual terms
- [ ] A language I'd like the site in
- [ ] I'd like to translate the site into a language
- [ ] I can review a language (I speak it natively and work in accessibility): add me to the translation reviewers (https://github.com/SureA11y/core/blob/main/docs/I18N.md#translation-reviewers)
